responsibility: This header declares the public entry points for loading RTL function bodies from serialized dump syntax. It exposes helpers to read a function from a file path or from a source-range within an input file, allowing selftests and debugging workflows to reconstruct GCC RTL functions from textual dumps.
same_name_distinction: Declares the small public API for loading RTL function bodies from files or source ranges, while read-rtl-function.cc contains the parser, reconstruction logic, and selftests.
